sources.note: Modular connector article (opened): 8P8C plug 22.48 mm long x 11.68 mm wide x 8.00 mm high, contact pitch 1.02 mm, quoting a Molex data sheet; IEC 60603-7 / ANSI/TIA-1096-A. Secondary source: the Molex data sheet itself could not be opened, so width and height still need a drawing check.
L-com TDS8P8C 8P8C plug listing (opened): length 0.880 in (22.35 mm), within 0.15 mm of the 22.48 mm length above.

Neutrik NE8FDP datasheet (opened): the etherCON receptacle accepts any standard RJ45 plug, so this plug goes into both an rj45 and an ethercon port (catalog matesWith rj45, ethercon). What the model is: the bare cable RJ45 plug (8P8C), role = plug, no mating diameter because the plug is rectangular. Body along +Z, mating face (contact end) at z = 0; w = 11.68 (x), h = 8.00 (y, latch side up), d = 22.48 (z).
